The day of the Wakagoma Stakes—a race 
taken on with eyes set on the Classics—has 
finally arrived.

Free of any nerves and brimming with 
unstoppable excitement and motivation, 
Tokai Teio takes a deep breath so she 
doesn't mess up from being overly eager.

To show the spectators the true power of 
this promising new star... she dashed out 
in high spirits!
